msg_content: {"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Hi everyone, today let's discuss the technical plan for the new project."}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"OK, let me start with the background. We need to build a knowledge base management system that imports many document formats, including PDF, Word and Markdown. It needs full-text search and semantic search, and it must isolate workspaces from each other."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Any suggestions for the tech stack?"}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"I suggest Go for the backend, PostgreSQL for the database, and Milvus or Qdrant for vector retrieval. The frontend can use React + TypeScript."}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Agreed. I did some research on document parsing:

1. PDF parsing can use the unstructured library, which extracts tables and images
2. Word documents can be parsed with the docx library
3. Markdown can use a standard parser
4. Scanned PDFs need an OCR service

The chunking strategy also matters. We need to support chunking by paragraph, by token count and by semantic boundary."}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Let me add to the vector retrieval part. The mainstream embedding models today are OpenAI's text-embedding-ada-002, the BGE series and M3E. We can add an abstraction layer so we can switch embedding models."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"OK, so how should we design permissions?"}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"We'll use an RBAC model with these levels:

- Super admin: global management permissions
- Workspace admin: manages a specific workspace
- Editor: can upload and edit documents
- Viewer: can only view and search

Each workspace is isolated and data is not shared between them."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"@Wang Wu have you settled the API gateway plan?"}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Yes, we'll use Kong as the API gateway, mainly for its plugin ecosystem and performance. For authentication we'll use JWT + OAuth 2.0 together."}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"I wrote up the full technical architecture:

[Frontend]
- React 18 + TypeScript
- Ant Design Pro component library
- TanStack Query for data fetching

[Gateway]
- Kong API Gateway
- JWT auth + rate limiting

[Services]
- Go 1.21 + Gin
- Microservices: user service, document service, retrieval service, knowledge base service

[Storage]
- PostgreSQL: business data
- Redis: cache and sessions
- MinIO: file storage
- Milvus: vector storage
- Elasticsearch: full-text search

[Infrastructure]
- Kubernetes deployment
- Prometheus + Grafana monitoring
- ELK logging

Anything to add?"}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Very thorough! A few more points:
1. GitHub Actions for CI/CD
2. Harbor for the container image registry
3. Nacos for the config center"}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"One more important question: chunk granularity. In my experience a chunk size of 512 to 1024 tokens works well, with 10%-20% overlap. Different document types may need different chunking strategies."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"I agree with Li Si. I also suggest a chunk preview feature, so users can preview the chunking after uploading a document and fix anything that looks wrong."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Good idea! That will make the user experience much better."}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Let's split the work:
- Zhang San (me): overall architecture and the user service
- Li Si: document parsing and chunking
- Wang Wu: API gateway and authentication
- Zhao Liu: vector retrieval and semantic search"}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"No problem. I expect a first prototype in two weeks."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"OK, I can finish the gateway part within a week."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Got it. I'll set up the Milvus cluster first, then write the retrieval service."}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"@all Progress update: the document parsing module now handles basic PDF and Word parsing, and I'm improving table recognition. One problem: text extraction is poor for some PDFs, so we may need OCR for them."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"PaddleOCR works well for the OCR service. It's open source and free."}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"OK, I'll try it. I also implemented three chunking strategies:
1. Fixed-length chunking (by token count)
2. Recursive character chunking (paragraph, then sentence, then character)
3. Semantic chunking (split points based on embedding similarity)

Semantic chunking gives the best results but is the slowest, so I suggest offering it as an advanced option."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"I can help optimize semantic chunking. Batching the embedding calls should speed it up a lot."}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"The API gateway is deployed and JWT auth is wired up. These endpoints work now:
- POST /api/v1/auth/login
- POST /api/v1/auth/register
- GET /api/v1/user/profile
- POST /api/v1/documents/upload
- GET /api/v1/documents/list
- POST /api/v1/search

I also generated the Swagger docs, take a look."}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Good progress! The user service is mostly done too, including sign-up, login, role management and workspace management. Tomorrow I start integration with Wang Wu."}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"The vector retrieval service is usable! I ran a simple benchmark:

- Data: 1 million vectors (768 dimensions)
- Index type: IVF_FLAT
- Query latency: P99 < 50ms
- Recall: top10 > 95%

That's plenty for our use case."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Great! Those numbers look good. We also need hybrid retrieval that combines vector retrieval with keyword retrieval, to improve search accuracy and coverage."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Already on it. I used RRF (Reciprocal Rank Fusion) to merge the two result lists. Early tests show it's about 20% better than a single retrieval path."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Integration went mostly smoothly. I found and fixed a few small issues. All endpoints work now, so we can start integration testing."}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Integration testing found a problem: with more than 50 concurrent uploads, the document processing queue backs up. @Li Si should we add a message queue as a buffer?"}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Yes, we need one. I'll add RabbitMQ as the task queue and make document processing asynchronous:
1. The upload endpoint returns a task_id immediately
2. A background worker takes tasks from the queue
3. When processing finishes, the frontend is notified over WebSocket

That way the upload endpoint never blocks."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"I also suggest a processing progress API, so the frontend can poll it or use SSE to show progress."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"I added the WebSocket gateway config, with long-lived connections and heartbeat checks."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"OK, that's settled. Next Monday we'll do a full code review, then prepare to deploy to the test environment."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Got it!"}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"OK"}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"No problem. I'll finish the retrieval service unit tests this weekend."}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"@all Reminder: the code review meeting is tomorrow at 2 PM. Please push your code to your feature branch beforehand.

Review focus:
1. Code style and naming
2. Error handling
3. Concurrency safety
4. Performance bottlenecks
5. Security vulnerabilities"}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Pushed, PR link: https://github.com/example/knowledgebase/pull/42"}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Mine is pushed too: https://github.com/example/knowledgebase/pull/43"}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Pushed: https://github.com/example/knowledgebase/pull/44\nUnit test coverage reached 85%."}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Code review summary:

Overall code quality is good. These areas need work:

[Li Si - document service]
- File upload lacks type validation, add an allowlist
- Large file processing needs a memory limit
- Consider adding document deduplication

[Wang Wu - gateway service]
- Rate limiting config needs finer granularity
- Logs should not print sensitive information
- Consider adding request ID tracing

[Zhao Liu - retrieval service]
- Vector dimensions should be configurable
- The search result cache strategy can be improved
- Consider supporting filters (by time, tag and so on)

Please finish the changes by Wednesday."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Got it. I can fix file type validation and the memory limit today. For deduplication I plan to use SimHash for near-duplicate detection. Is that OK?"}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Yes, SimHash works well for text deduplication. Use MD5 for exact duplicates first, then SimHash for near duplicates, as two filter layers."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"I changed rate limiting to limit per user and per endpoint. For request ID tracing I use the X-Request-ID header across the whole call chain."}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Vector dimensions are configurable now. The search cache uses an LRU policy with a 5-minute expiry. For filters I support these dimensions:
- Time range
- Document tags
- Workspace
- Document type
- Custom metadata fields"}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"All changes are merged and we're ready to deploy to the test environment. @Wang Wu please confirm the K8s cluster resource config."}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Test environment resources:

- User service: 2 cores 4G × 2 replicas
- Document service: 4 cores 8G × 3 replicas (needs more memory for large files)
- Retrieval service: 4 cores 8G × 2 replicas
- Gateway service: 2 cores 4G × 2 replicas
- PostgreSQL: 8 cores 16G
- Redis: 4 cores 8G
- Milvus: 8 cores 32G
- MinIO: 4 cores 8G

About 60 cores and 128G in total."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"That's enough resources. Go ahead and deploy. Once it's done, everyone verifies the modules they own."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"I deployed the Milvus cluster in advance and configured data persistence."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Should the number of document processing workers be configurable? Right now the default is 3 concurrent workers."}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Yes, an environment variable is enough. 3 is enough for the test environment; production may need more."}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Document upload and processing verified. I tested these formats:
✅ PDF (plain text)
✅ PDF (with tables)
✅ PDF (scanned + OCR)
✅ Word (.docx)
✅ Markdown
✅ TXT
❌ Excel (not supported yet, planned for the next release)"}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Retrieval verified. I tested importing and searching 100 documents, and result relevance is decent. One problem: when the query is very short (two or three words), vector retrieval gets worse. I suggest special handling for short queries, such as preferring keyword retrieval."}}

{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Good suggestion, I'll add it to the optimization list. That's it for the first version. Next week we invite internal users to try it and collect feedback.\n\nThanks for the hard work everyone, the project is going very well!"}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Let's go! 💪"}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Let's do this together!"}}
{"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"Looking forward to user feedback!"}}
